required_release_lane.purpose: Required Rust release-candidate lane for stable DAG behavior that must stay green in CI.

full_verification_lane.purpose: Full workspace Rust verification, including governed ignored DAG test portfolios.

portfolios.rationale: Adapter contracts cover broader scenario-matrix and handshake behavior that is still required evidence, but they are too slow for the required release lane.
portfolios.full_lane_command: cargo nextest run -p bijux-dag-app --test adapter_command_contract --run-ignored only --config-file configs/rust/nextest.toml --profile ci --status-level all --final-status-level all
